label: Cursor
depicts: Solid pointer arrow outline leaning slightly left with a thick lower tail
use_when: Use when the interface wants a simple pointer arrow without click sparks or open center lines.
avoid_when: Do not use for the open arrow or click pointer when the thick solid arrow body matters.

label: Cursor
depicts: Open pointer arrow outline leaning right with a separated lower tail line
use_when: Use when the interface wants a lighter open pointer shape instead of a solid triangular arrow.
avoid_when: Do not use for the solid pointer when the open center and separated tail are visible.

label: Cursor
depicts: Pointer arrow outline with four short click rays at the upper left
use_when: Use when the interface wants a cursor icon that explicitly shows a click or tap burst.
avoid_when: Do not use for the plain pointer arrows when the short click rays are part of the visual.

label: Hand Finger
depicts: Rounded hand outline with one raised index finger and a closed palm loop
use_when: Use when the interface wants a touch hand icon built as one rounded palm loop and one raised finger.
avoid_when: Do not use for the detailed finger hand when the palm should stay as one simple loop.

label: Hand Finger
depicts: Hand outline with one raised index finger and several curved finger bumps
use_when: Use when the interface wants the raised finger hand that also shows the other curled finger bumps.
avoid_when: Do not use for the simpler looped palm hand when the extra finger bumps need to remain visible.
